attractions.name: Minneriya National Park
attractions.description: Famed for 'The Gathering', when large herds of wild Asian elephants congregate around the reservoir in the dry season; also spotted deer, monkeys, peacocks and sometimes leopards
tips: Jeep safari is best started early, around 6 AM
